user.title: Choose your car
user.description: Clockwatch writes a receipt for every charge and every drive of this car.

car.title: The car's sensors
car.description: Found automatically from Teslemetry; change any that are wrong. Charging state, charger power, odometer and gear are needed. Teslemetry switches some of these off by default; switched off here: {disabled}. Turn them on under the car's device page, wait a minute, then continue.

data.location_entity: Location (optional; only the zone name is kept)

data_description.energy_remaining_entity: Gives the most accurate energy for each trip. Without it, the battery percentage and size are used.
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Used when energy remaining is not available. About 57.5 kWh for a Model 3 RWD, 75 kWh for a Long Range.

home.title: Your home's energy
home.description: Where each charge's energy comes from. Leave all four empty if you have no solar or home battery: every charge is then counted as grid.

data.load_power_entity: Home power (everything the house uses, including the car)

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: A price sensor is used when chosen; the fixed price fills in when it has no value.

data.solar_value: Solar energy in the car is worth

data_description.solar_value: The export price is what you gave up by putting the sunshine in the car instead of selling it.

compare.title: The petrol car to compare with

data.min_trip_miles: Shortest trip that gets a receipt

error.not_reporting: This sensor has no value yet. If Teslemetry switched it off, turn it on and wait a minute.

abort.no_cars: No Teslemetry car found. Set up the Teslemetry integration first.

init.description: Charging state, charger power, odometer and gear are needed. Switched off: {disabled}.
